Messages.Author: pallando
Messages.Body:
truman is blocked by wolf valentine. wolf strikes blissful agony at superior
and says truman is in combat with minion x controlled by a third player.

karl (controlled by the same player as truman) plays coordinate attacks.
does this prevent truman from entering combat with minion x? i would say
yes.

another question: ilse has received a diarm at superior. she now plays a
torn signpost (SUP). what happens to her strength? i would say her strength
is set to 3 and then reduced by 2 by the disarm. is this correct?

regards,

pallando

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
pallando wrote:
> truman is blocked by wolf valentine. wolf strikes blissful agony at superior
> and says truman is in combat with minion x controlled by a third player.
>
> karl (controlled by the same player as truman) plays coordinate attacks.
> does this prevent truman from entering combat with minion x? i would say
> yes.

Coordinate Attacks cannot be played - By the time combat is ending, Truman
is already entering combat with another minion - a new combat cannot be
queued. cf. Illusions of the Kindred vs. Psyche!

> another question: ilse has received a diarm at superior. she now plays a
> torn signpost (SUP). what happens to her strength? i would say her strength
> is set to 3 and then reduced by 2 by the disarm. is this correct?

Yes. Modifiers still apply.
